title: Voltara's reactors run wild
text: Voltara's reactors ran past quota and no one dared shut them. Energy there costs less and pays less. The cores hum louder, pleased with themselves. Buy while the Plan argues about it.

title: Grey blight on Tillam's terraces
text: A grey blight is eating Tillam's terraces. Leaves come apart like wet paper. Food there is dear now and pays well. The committee will study the blight. The blight will not wait for the committee.

title: Ashgate's harvest comes in heavy
text: Ashgate brought in more than the Plan allowed for. Food there costs less and pays less. A surplus is a gift to the Commons, until it rots on the dock. Someone has to move it.

title: Voltara's crews go hungry
text: Voltara's crews work long shifts on short rations. Less food arrived than was counted. Food there costs more and pays more. The Bureau cut every ration by the same amount and called it fair. The crews call it hunger.

title: Frost on Tillam
text: Winter came early to Tillam and the heaters never stop. Energy there costs more and pays more. Frost has begun to grow inside the ducts, in patterns no one will explain. Someone must keep the lights on.

title: Ashgate lights every furnace
text: Ashgate relit every foundry to meet a plan that arrived this morning. Energy there costs more and pays more. The furnaces glare through the smoke. Nobody asked where the power comes from. Someone with a ship will carry it.

title: Tillam's docks go on strike
text: Tillam's dock crews walked out. The committee calls it a misunderstanding. The port is closed for a while, and routes touching Tillam are blocked until it reopens. The ships wait outside and take no side.

title: Ashgate seals its port
text: Something was found in Ashgate's lower docks. The doctors will only say the port is closed. Routes touching Ashgate are blocked until they say otherwise. Caution is shared equally, and so is the fear.

title: Voltara goes dark
text: A fault in Voltara's grid took the port down with it. The planet that powers everyone cannot light its own docks. The port is closed for a while, and routes touching Voltara are blocked. The Plan will be revised, backwards.

title: A lender walks Tillam's market
text: A lender's agent walked Tillam's market and bought every debt in sight. Sellers settled what they owed and dumped what they had. Energy there costs less and pays less for now. Even a society that owns everything together finds a way to owe.

title: Ashgate's foreman says enough
text: An Ashgate foreman read the numbers, declared the shift had made enough, and sent the crews home. Energy there costs less and pays less. Enough is a figure the Plan does not print. The word crossed the docks faster than any form.

title: Voltara buys before the news
text: Word from the other systems arrives late, and Voltara's buyers would not wait for it. They bought hard, so energy there costs more and pays more. Out past the beacons the dark is patient. It is the one thing nobody is asked to share.

title: A family buys Ashgate's food
text: A family with old credits quietly bought every food contract on Ashgate. Food there costs more and pays more. The Commons owns everything together, and here is a piece still for sale. You are in no position to judge.

title: The inspector's count
text: An inspector counted Voltara's food stores and found them sufficient, on a form. The market believed the form, so food there costs less and pays less. The crews are still hungry, now correctly accounted for.

title: Tillam's festival of founders
text: Tillam declared a festival to honour its founders. Three committees claim to be them. Food there costs more and pays more. Everyone agrees on the feast. Nobody agrees who is hosting, so nobody clears the tables.

title: A ship leaves Tillam half empty
text: A ship left Tillam half empty, bound for a rock nobody has charted. Those who stayed sold their spare food to pay for staying. Food there costs less and pays less. The departure form was filed in advance. The return form was not.
